subject: prd/plan-new
statement: Frozen plan/v1 artifacts remain byte-immutable and valid inputs to their existing downstream compatibility path; from §6.5's Stage-0 plan/v2 schema cutover onward, plan-new creates only plan/v2 and never backfills or infers execution-demand fields into plan/v1.
rationale: merge freezes planning judgment; post-freeze inference violates provenance
fit_criterion: frozen plan/v1 corpus byte-identical and accepted; zero v1 writes; every plan frozen from Stage 1 onward is v2 and satisfies FR-28/FR-29/FR-30
